name: Client schedule to ledger reconciliation
summary: When a client's subledger schedule and trial balance disagree, the responsible accountant gets one worksheet: both balances proved, every timing difference and unexplained entry listed, and the next step for each. Nothing is posted; every explanation waits for a person.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own published map of the work, written from how accountants reconcile a client's subledger schedule to its trial balance. No third-party text.
